problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate cargo space for nine distinct categories of goods, each requiring passage through nine sequential handling stages. The revenue generated per ton of each good category is listed below:
* For Category Alpha, revenue is 14.014 per ton
* For Category Beta, revenue is 9.416 per ton
* For Category Gamma, revenue is 10.126 per ton
* For Category Delta, revenue is 6.368 per ton
* For Category Epsilon, revenue is 10.775 per ton
* For Category Zeta, revenue is 8.934 per ton
* For Category Eta, revenue is 10.23 per ton
* For Category Theta, revenue is 14.371 per ton
* For Category Iota, revenue is 15.275 per ton

The handling duration per ton for each stage is as follows:
*For Category Alpha, Stage 1 consumes 1.547 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.599 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.53 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.943 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.04 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.056 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.349 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 1.437 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 0.51 (ton-hours)
*For Category Beta, Stage 1 consumes 0.294 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.652 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.939 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.798 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.303 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.407 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.513 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 0.713 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 1.057 (ton-hours)
*For Category Gamma, Stage 1 consumes 1.173 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.745 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.865 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.564 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.328 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.335 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.672 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 1.692 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 1.655 (ton-hours)
*For Category Delta, Stage 1 consumes 1.696 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.513 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.818 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.73 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.676 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.203 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.484 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 0.826 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 0.62 (ton-hours)
*For Category Epsilon, Stage 1 consumes 1.773 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.286 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.001 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.882 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.757 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.704 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.784 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 1.421 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 1.027 (ton-hours)
*For Category Zeta, Stage 1 consumes 0.65 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.454 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.037 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.452 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.528 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.212 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.676 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 0.447 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 0.219 (ton-hours)
*For Category Eta, Stage 1 consumes 0.962 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.389 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.688 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.713 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.323 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.067 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.809 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 0.802 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 0.285 (ton-hours)
*For Category Theta, Stage 1 consumes 1.136 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.996 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.473 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.421 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.889 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.277 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.949 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 0.565 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 1.53 (ton-hours)
*For Category Iota, Stage 1 consumes 1.211 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.254 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.52 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.95 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.469 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.488 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.23 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 1.173 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 0.98 (ton-hours)

* The cumulative handling duration for Stage 1 must remain within 200.198 ton-hours
* The cumulative handling duration for Stage 2 must remain within 112.28 ton-hours
* The cumulative handling duration for Stage 3 must remain within 184.976 ton-hours
* The cumulative handling duration for Stage 4 must remain within 219.839 ton-hours
* The cumulative handling duration for Stage 5 must remain within 135.661 ton-hours
* The cumulative handling duration for Stage 6 must remain within 153.716 ton-hours
* The cumulative handling duration for Stage 7 must remain within 105.739 ton-hours
* The cumulative handling duration for Stage 8 must remain within 176.341 ton-hours
* The cumulative handling duration for Stage 9 must remain within 149.161 ton-hours

Under the condition that for each handling stage—Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3, Stage 4, Stage 5, Stage 6, Stage 7, Stage 8, Stage 9—the total processing duration does not exceed its allotted capacity, determine the optimal tonnage allocation for each category of goods to maximize total revenue.
